description: Commits to an offer, creating an exchange and minting a voucher NFT. Caller is the buyer (signerAddress) unless 'buyer' param is set. For ERC-20 offers, call approve_exchange_token first. In metaTx mode, you can skip the approval by passing transferAuthorizations (built with a sign_receive_with_* tool) to send_meta_transaction. Returns unsigned transaction data.

buyer.description: Optional buyer address if different from signerAddress. When set, executionMode must be 'direct'.

configId.description: Boson/Fermion Protocol deployment identifier. Format: '<env>-<chainId>-<index>' e.g. 'production-137-0' (Polygon mainnet), 'testing-80002-0' (Amoy testnet). Call get_config_ids to list all valid values for this server.

executionMode.description: 'direct' = standard on-chain tx (sign locally with your wallet → send_signed_transaction). 'metaTx' = gasless relay via Biconomy (send_meta_transaction). Defaults to 'direct'.

offerId.description: ID of the active offer to commit to. Creates an exchange and mints a voucher NFT.

signerAddress.description: Ethereum address that will sign and send this transaction. Must match the wallet that will sign the returned transaction locally.

name: commit_to_offer
